description.value: Mostafa Supermarket is a halal greengrocer and supermarket serving the Edmonds area of Burnaby. It stocks produce and grocery items under halal certification, making it a practical resupply stop for cyclists on routes through the area. The shop operates seven days a week with extended morning-to-evening hours.

bike_parking_detail: 1 rack within 100m: stands (4 spaces, covered) at 50m. Total: 4 spaces.
